input: I am about to write into the P1 findings memo the cost-base and context findings: the upfront investment figures, 5,674 dollars with 279 dollars monthly fixed costs, remain structurally valid but none of the founder-personal-exposure items are started, the EU AI Act Article 50 date of 2 August 2026 imposes a schedule the pre-pivot plan never carried, and the June-15 Anthropic credit-pool change sanctioning third-party agents under 20-to-200-dollar monthly caps mildly strengthens the agent-consumer thesis while adding a watch item on the founder's own usage costs.
